name: RPG Map Editor
author: ct
description: Editor of the rpg mod's tile maps (maps/*.json): paints the back, main and front tile layers and the collision layer with a pencil, an eraser and a flood fill from the tileset palette, places and edits map events (look, trigger, scenario, inline commands, teleport, condition), sets the map size, spawn and random encounters. Undo/redo, live update of the running world after saving, play from the spawn. Opens from the main menu tools, the novel editor hub and the in-game toolbar.
